about: English voice-over: one clip per locales.json "en" key (a value variant as key.<value>), as Hindi, Marathi and Gujarati have. The clips with "from" are the game's own English recordings (the lesson's Ogg clips copied as they are; the fishing game's MP3s, its files and Popo's embedded clips, kept as masters/<file>.mp3); "to_record" lists the lines still to record with ElevenLabs (tools/vo_lang_record.js en: set voices.swiftee.voice_id to Swiftee's English studio voice first). tools/vo_lang_build.js en makes the clips (Ogg Opus 32 kbps mono, -16.4 LUFS) and vo_en.js.

AO = 6 cm. What is the
length of OC?
clips.spoken: In this parallelogram, A O equals six centimetres. What is the length of O C?

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.text:
Yes! O cuts AC in half,
so OC = 6 cm.
clips.spoken: Yes! O cuts A C in half, so O C equals six centimetres.

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.text: OC is not half of AO. OC = AO.
clips.spoken: O C is not half of A O. O C equals A O.

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.text: 12 cm is the whole of AC. OC is only half of it.
clips.spoken: Twelve centimetres is the whole of A C. O C is only half of it.

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.text:
In this *parallelogram*,
AO = 5 cm and BO = 3 cm.
Find the lengths of
OC and OD.
clips.spoken: In this parallelogram, A O equals five centimetres and B O equals three centimetres. Find the lengths of O C and O D.

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.text:
Well done! OC = AO = 5 cm
and OD = BO = 3 cm.
clips.spoken: Well done! O C equals A O equals five centimetres and O D equals B O equals three centimetres.

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.text: OC is the other half of AC, so OC = AO.
clips.spoken: O C is the other half of A C, so O C equals A O.

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.text: OD is the other half of BD, so OD = BO.
clips.spoken: O D is the other half of B D, so O D equals B O.

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.text:
Which of the following are
true for this *parallelogram*?
Select all that apply.
clips.spoken: Which of the following are true for this parallelogram? Select all that apply.

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.text:
Perfect! AO = OC, BO = OD,
so the *diagonals* *bisect*
each other.
clips.spoken: Perfect! A O equals O C, B O equals O D, so the diagonals bisect each other.

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.text: AO and BO are parts of different *diagonals*, so they need not be *equal*.
clips.spoken: A O and B O are parts of different diagonals, so they need not be equal.

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.text: The two *diagonals* of this *parallelogram* have different lengths.
clips.spoken: The two diagonals of this parallelogram have different lengths.

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.text:
Let's recall what we learnt
about *parallelograms*.
clips.spoken: Let's recall what we learnt about parallelograms.

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.text:
Amazing work! You know all
about *parallelograms* now.
clips.spoken: Amazing work! You know all about parallelograms now.

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.text: BC is not *parallel* to AD yet. Keep dragging B to the right.
clips.spoken: B C is not parallel to A D yet. Keep dragging B to the right.

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.text: B went too far. Drag it back a little.
clips.spoken: B went too far. Drag it back a little.

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.spoken: Not quite. Try again.

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.text: A *parallelogram* is a *quadrilateral* with two pairs of *opposite* *sides* *parallel*.
clips.spoken: A parallelogram is a quadrilateral with two pairs of opposite sides parallel.

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.spoken: Opposite sides are parallel.

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.spoken: Opposite sides are equal.

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.spoken: Opposite angles are equal.

clips.speaker: swiftee
clips.spoken: Adjacent angles are supplementary. They add up to one hundred and eighty degrees.
